content.comment_body: Hello, I am encountering an issue where I can establish a connection using [product_name] flexible and [product_name] [article_no], but not between [product_name] [article_no] and a [product_name] HMI panel. My program version is [version_no] and it switches Q1. I want to use a button on the HMI ([version_no]) to switch Q1, but the connection between [product_name] [article_no] and the HMI panel with [product_name] software doesn't work. How do you set up a connection from HMI to [product_name] software [version_no]? Details: connection is via [product_name] Portal [version_no]. Type: [product_name] or [product_name]. Tag table is [version_no], BOOL 100ms. IP addresses are set correctly. In the visualization, there's a button event to invert the tag ([version_no]). The issue seems to be in [product_name] software [version_no]—how do I configure it so pressing the button on the HMI panel changes Q1? I know the programming steps, but how do I set the connection? Thank you.
Did you refer to this website? [url] There are examples showing communication between [product_name] and [product_name], as well as versions of [product_name] and [product_name] flexible.

Hello, thanks for the information. The process is quite different in [product_name] software [version_no]. I did find and resolve my problem. Now, I want to view my control panel remotely. How can I do that—do I need software on my tablet, like VNC? The smart server always requests a license key on the tablet.

Hi, For remote operation you have two options: 1. Use a [company_name] Comfort Panel and the comfort edition of [product_name] Portal (I'm unsure if [product_name] flexible offers this too). Enable the Web-Server on the comfort panel, and you may need additional software. 2. Generate a text message in [product_name] [version_no]. It has a built-in Web-Server where messages can be displayed, and you just need to enable the Web-Server feature. On your remote device, no extra software is needed—you connect through your Internet browser. Hope this helps.
Sir, What specific issue did you face connecting [product_name] [version_no] to your HMI screen? Best regards, [user_name]

You cannot set up this connection in [product_name] software. The configuration must be done in your HMI panels using [product_name]. In [product_name], you should add a new connection and correctly configure the IP address of your [product_name]. Then, you can verify the connection. If you continue to have problems, let us know and we can assist further.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered challenges establishing communication and control between [product_name] [version_no] and an HMI panel using [product_name] software [version_no]. The setup process is unclear, leading to confusion about the correct procedures and which system component handles the configuration. The solution clarified that connection setup must be done within the HMI's software, not directly via [product_name] software. Users also faced complications regarding remote access to control panels from tablets, particularly license restrictions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a straightforward way to connect [product_name] [version_no] with an HMI panel through [product_name] software, enabling direct remote control of outputs and seamless access via tablet devices without further licensing or technical obstacles.
